title: Saudi Arabian Kippers Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring kippers kebabs marinated in a blend of Saudi and Arabian spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together dum ghee, Saudi Arabian spice blend, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced tomatoes, sauteed onions, and chopped cilantro to the marinade. Mix well.
Thread the kippers onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kippers with the marinade, making sure they are evenly coated.
Grill the kippers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the kippers kebabs hot with additional marinade sauce for dipping.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati rice or flatbread.
